summary: Identity flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use confidence and compassion with awareness.
body: Identity flow with imagination and longing. This fluid pattern asks you to use confidence and compassion with awareness. Imaginative and compassionate; creative and charitable directions come naturally. The pattern can flow easily, which is useful when it is conscious and easy to take for granted when it is not. In practice, this can show up through identity, imagination and longing, and the choices you make when ego defense or confusion starts running the room.
gift: The gift is confidence, compassion, and a more conscious way to work with identity and imagination and longing.
shadow: The shadow is ego defense, confusion, and repeating the same pattern without noticing what it is trying to teach.
integration: Let identity and imagination and longing cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
do: Name how identity and imagination and longing are both involved
Turn confidence and compassion into one concrete choice
dont: Let ego defense make the decision
Ignore the needs of identity or imagination and longing
